description: Generate a dynamic delivery URL for an asset with transformation parameters (e.g. width, height, format, smart crop)

id.description: The unique ID of the asset

params.description: Query parameters string for transformations. Supports standard params (w, h, fmt) and MIMI generative AI: mimi=<prompt> (2K standard), mimi_mode=lite|standard|4k for quality tier, upscale=4k for a free preview-faithful 4K export, mimi_bg=<prompt> for generative background swap (e.g. 'w=500&h=500&mimi=make it cinematic&upscale=4k')

name: get_rendered_asset_url
